name: local-onenote-control
description: Control local Microsoft OneNote through a Windows desktop MCP bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Read and update local OneNote notebooks.
interface.longDescription: A local Windows MCP bridge for Microsoft OneNote desktop. It can list notebooks, sections, and pages, open a page in OneNote, read page text, create pages, and append text through OneNote COM automation.
defaultPrompt: Find OneNote pages matching a title.
Append this note to a OneNote page.
